def atomic_write(path, value, mode):
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".userbot-public-", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as out:
            out.write(value)
        os.chmod(tmp, mode)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
